method: Independent script/source-control comparison and direct visual inspection of all nine newly rendered final PNGs. Hashes computed after lossless PNG normalization. This is visual/source fidelity review, not print or structural certification.
source_basis: January2004 official survey report, PDF253–259 plans/elevations/sections; authored observations only, no source images included.

resolved_findings: East service four-group fields moved to correct east-return planes, with staggered lower sills and low upper-floor positions.
West shoulder ground division corrected to three rows.
Missing north/south shoulder-side narrow windows restored and small forward-tower base grille included.
North whole elevation frame now includes full pole.
Courtyard side four-per-floor plan marks represented separately as explicitly neutral proxies, not borrowed service grids.
limitations: Raster-scaled geometry and heights are approximate rather than exact printed dimension chains.
Courtyard side window count/positions are plan-supported; sill/height and unsegmented pane are authored display proxies, not known historic joinery.
Fine diamond grille infill, exact clock markings, surface colors, tiny ornament, rainwater fittings, roof material detail and weathering are simplified or omitted.
Window members are enlarged display geometry with opaque glazing; door recesses have authored blind backing, not complete interiors.
East elevated passages end at declared survey scope without fabricated terminal facade; continuation buildings excluded.
2004 survey-era exterior study, not certified current condition or complete original restoration. No physical trial print or structural-safety conclusion.
